entries.text_de:
Cambridge Corpus Christi College 422, früher The Rede boke of Derbye. P. 16, 11. Jh. (mitten im Salomon und Saturn) Excom. V, u. S. 435.

p. 310, 11. Jh., and. Hd., Excom. VI, u. S. 436.

p. 319, um 1070, neue Lage, stofflich (laut Hervorhebung dortiger Localheiligen) aus Winchester, Iud. Dei I ff., u. S. 401.
entries.text_en:
Cambridge Corpus Christi College 422, formerly The Rede boke of Derbye. P. 16, 11th century (in the middle of the Salomon and Saturn) Excom. V, below, p. 435.

p. 310, 11th century, another hand, Excom. VI, below, p. 436.

p. 319, c. 1070, a new quire, by its content (to judge by the prominence given to local saints there) from Winchester, Iud. Dei I ff., below, p. 401.

transcription.proof_notes: doubts: 'Iud.' confirmed in print; doubt removed
